messages.subject: Project Aquilo - draft board minutes
messages.plaintextBody:
Naomi,

Draft board minutes for Harrow approving entry into the Calderwater agreement are with you separately (HPE_Calderwater_BoardMinutes_Harrow). They record the key agreed terms - £4m liability cap, £5m IP sub-cap, 8% shortfall, 4% CPI cap, 45-day payment, 24-month warranty - and authorise Gavin to execute. Please arrange for the board to approve before signing on 8 April.

Best,

Sarah Whitfield
